summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_3 fixes (desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844, light and dark mode). All 4 iteration_3 issues are FIXED. (1) Peach is gone: a source grep for FFF3E2/F6CFA6/F7D3AE/FFF6EA/FFF6E8/F6D9B9/E9A877 returns nothing, and a scan of computed styles (including ::before/::after) on /, the not-found page, /home, /profile/you, /passport/you and /explore found 0 peach elements. The teal moon gradient (#F3FBF9/#BFEDE4) is present, .gm-moon computes to radial #F3FBF9 -> #BFEDE4 -> #3DB6A4, and the profile SVG fill is #F3FBF9. (2) Dark neutrals are now teal: body is rgb(10,15,14) with text rgb(230,241,238). The home 'No saved milestones yet' card (bg-gray-50/60) is rgba(28,40,38,0.6) and the profile 'Set Focus Waypoints' section (bg-gray-50/70) is rgba(28,40,38,0.7), so they are dark teal cards, not cream. (3) Dark CTAs (New Journey, Create Your First Journey, Add Update, Add First Update, Post Update, mobile FAB, Follow, Passport, Share a Milestone) render the #2DD4BF -> #5EEAD4 gradient with text #04211E. (4) The former black-ink CTAs (composer Post Update and '+', View Profile arrow, Builders ahead arrow, home 'For you' chip, landing Get Started and Start your journey, logged-out TopBar Sign Up, post-card Follow and Passport, Explore icon button) all compute to linear-gradient(90deg, #0B4F4A -> #14B8A6) with white text in light mode. Regressions pass: arjun_sharma third-person copy vs owner copy on /profile/you, QR modal Escape, lightbox Escape on /updates/u3, mobile Goals inputs 44px, Add Goal disabled, the account-menu theme toggle, the mobile bottom nav, the teal nav pill and tabs, and the landing layout. One new dark-mode contrast bug was found in the home composer type pills.

ui_bugs.component: Home inline composer - quick type pills (Progress/Milestone/Challenge/Lesson)
ui_bugs.issue: In DARK mode the active pill uses 'bg-gm-ink text-white'. gm-ink becomes light rgb(230,241,238) in dark mode, so the result is white text on a near-white pill and the label is unreadable (confirmed by screenshot and computed styles). Fix: use bg-gm-accent text-white (the gradient, which gets dark text in dark mode) or text-gm-paper. File: app/home/page.tsx:751.

issues: The logo moon's crescent mask uses the ink colour, which turns light in dark mode. The logo therefore looks like an almost solid pale disk with only a faint crescent, which loses the moon shape. Consider a dark mask colour in dark mode.
The active 'For you' chip is still bg-gm-ink: black in light mode and a light flat chip in dark mode. On /home the active 'For you' chip is now the teal gradient, so the two pages are inconsistent.
Still a flat bg-gm-ink: black in light mode and a near-white pill in dark mode. It is not part of the teal CTA system. Minor.

design_issues.screen: Login/Register submit buttons, auth callback, messages empty-state button
issues: These still use bg-gm-ink (black) primary buttons: app/login/page.tsx:246, app/register/page.tsx:267, app/auth/callback/page.tsx:229, app/messages/page.tsx:595. They were not in this round's scope, but they are inconsistent with the gradient primary CTA rule.

action_items: Fix the dark-mode unreadable active composer type pill at app/home/page.tsx:751. Replace 'bg-gm-ink text-white' with 'bg-gm-accent text-white' or 'bg-gm-ink text-gm-paper'.
Optional: make the Explore active category chip match the home chip (gradient).
Optional: switch the login/register/messages/auth-callback primary buttons from bg-gm-ink to bg-gm-accent text-white for CTA consistency.
Optional: keep the TopBar logo crescent mask dark in dark mode.
critical_code_review_comments: Any 'bg-gm-ink text-white' combination breaks in dark mode, because ink inverts to light while text-white stays white. Audit and swap these to text-gm-paper. The home composer pills are one confirmed instance.
app/profile/[username]/page.tsx is over 2000 lines and should be split (carried over from earlier iterations).

success_rate.frontend: ~96% (all 4 iteration_3 issues plus the CTA consistency fixes verified; 1 new medium dark-mode contrast bug)
